title: 15 Day Kenya and Tanzania Birding Safari
rank_math_title: Kenya and Tanzania Birding Safari: 15 Amazing Days
rank_math_desc: Kenya and Tanzania birding safari for 15 days: Tsavo West, Amboseli, Arusha NP, Tarangire, Ngorongoro, Serengeti and Lake Manyara. Price on request.
post_content: This Kenya and Tanzania birding safari crosses the border at Namanga to combine Tsavo and Amboseli with Tanzania's northern circuit.
overview:
This Kenya and Tanzania birding safari is a two-country journey for birders who also want the great game parks. It starts in Tsavo West, crosses into Tanzania near Amboseli and visits every park on the northern circuit.

Tanzania adds several birds you will not see in Kenya, such as the ashy starling and Fischer's lovebird, while Kenya's dry south adds Taveta golden weaver and many arid-country species.

Why choose this Kenya and Tanzania birding safari?

  • Tsavo West and Amboseli: sandgrouse, pygmy falcon and Taveta golden weaver.
  • Angata plains: a search for the rare Beesley's lark.
  • Arusha NP and Tarangire: turacos, trogons, ashy starling and yellow-collared lovebird.
  • Ngorongoro: highland widowbirds, then crowned cranes and bustards in the crater.
  • Serengeti and Manyara: vultures, raptors, flamingos and pelicans.

Where you stay

Kitani Safari Camp in Tsavo West, Amboseli Sentrim Camp, Impala Hotel in Arusha, Momella Lodge, Tarangire Sopa Lodge, Ngorongoro Sopa Lodge, Serengeti Sopa Lodge and Lake Manyara Hotel, or similar.

Best time for a Kenya and Tanzania birding safari

November to April is excellent, with migrants present and the southern Serengeti full of wildebeest. June to October is dry, with great game viewing in Tarangire and the Serengeti.

Read our guide to Tanzania national parks, see all Tanzania safaris or browse birding safaris. For park rules, see Tanzania National Parks.

faq.q: Do I need visas for both countries?
faq.a: Yes. You need a Kenya eTA and a Tanzania visa. We will send you the current requirements when you book.

faq.q: Where do we cross the border?
faq.a: At Namanga, between Amboseli and Arusha. Your guide helps with the formalities.

faq.q: Which lodges are used on the Kenya and Tanzania birding safari?
faq.a: Kitani Safari Camp, Amboseli Sentrim Camp, Impala Hotel, Momella Lodge, Tarangire Sopa, Ngorongoro Sopa, Serengeti Sopa and Lake Manyara Hotel, or similar.

faq.q: How many species can I expect?
faq.a: Most groups record 400 to 500 species in 15 days.

faq.q: Is the Ngorongoro Crater fee included?
faq.a: Yes, park and crater fees are included in your quote.

faq.q: How do I get back to Nairobi?
faq.a: On the last day a shuttle runs from Arusha to Nairobi airport, or you can fly from Arusha or Kilimanjaro.

faq.q: Is there a yellow fever requirement?
faq.a: Tanzania may ask for a yellow fever certificate depending on your route. We will advise you before you travel.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Nairobi to Tsavo West
itinerary.content: Morning pick-up at Nairobi airport and drive to Tsavo West with birding stops near Hunter's Lodge. Overnight at Kitani Safari Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Tsavo West to Amboseli
itinerary.content: Drive through dry scrub to Amboseli. Evening game drive. Overnight at Amboseli Sentrim Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Amboseli National Park
itinerary.content: Morning and evening drives for pygmy falcon, Taveta golden weaver and elephants below Kilimanjaro.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Amboseli to Arusha
itinerary.content: Cross into Tanzania at Namanga, with a stop on the Angata plains for Beesley's lark. Overnight at Impala Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Arusha National Park
itinerary.content: Forest, scrub and crater lakes for Hartlaub's turaco, bar-tailed trogon and flamingos. Overnight at Momella Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Momella Lakes to Tarangire
itinerary.content: Morning at the Momella Lakes, then drive to Tarangire Sopa Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
itinerary.content: A full day among baobabs for ashy starling, yellow-collared lovebird and secretary birds.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro highlands
itinerary.content: Climb to the crater rim for widowbirds, Schalow's turaco and sunbirds. Overnight at Ngorongoro Sopa Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.content: A crater floor game drive for crowned cranes, kori bustards and Fischer's lovebirds.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro to the Serengeti
itinerary.content: Drive into the central Serengeti. Overnight at Serengeti Sopa Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 11
itinerary.title: Central Serengeti
itinerary.content: Plains and kopje birding for Hildebrandt's starling and rosy-patched shrike.

itinerary.label: Day 12
itinerary.title: Ndutu area
itinerary.content: A full day at Ndutu for vultures, eagles and spotted eagle-owl.

itinerary.label: Day 13
itinerary.title: Serengeti to Lake Manyara
itinerary.content: Drive to Lake Manyara. Overnight at Lake Manyara Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 14
itinerary.title: Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.content: Lakeside birding for flamingos, pelicans and silvery-cheeked hornbill.

itinerary.label: Day 15
itinerary.title: Manyara to Nairobi
itinerary.content: Drive to Arusha and take the shuttle to Nairobi airport for your evening flight.
